errors.text_span: Оста X е обозначена с етикет, показващ броя на етапите на обучение
errors.evidence: The X-axis does not have a visible label. The description of what it represents is inferred from the caption, but the text incorrectly claims a label exists on the axis itself.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с етикет, показващ ефективния ранг (W)
errors.evidence: The Y-axis does not have a visible label. The description of what it represents is inferred from the caption, but the text incorrectly claims a label exists on the axis itself.

errors.text_span: но няма ясно изписани единици или конкретни стойности по оста
errors.evidence: The Y-axis clearly shows numerical tick labels at 40, 45, and 50.

errors.text_span: диапазонът на стойностите е приблизително от 40 до 50
errors.evidence: The range of values on the Y-axis extends above 50, with the blue line (N=1) starting at approximately 53.

errors.text_span: Линия 1 (синя) остава почти постоянна около 50 през всички етапи на обучение.
errors.evidence: This description is an over-generalization. The blue line (N=1) starts at a much higher value (around 53) and drops sharply to 50 before becoming constant. The initial drop is a notable feature that is missed.
The orange line (N=2) clearly starts at a value above 50, approximately at 52.

errors.text_span: Линия 3 (зелена) започва малко под 50 и намалява до около 45.
errors.evidence: The green line (N=3) starts slightly above 50 (approx. 50.5), not below it. Its final value is closer to 46, not 45.

errors.text_span: Няма ясно видими върхове или спадове освен началните промени при малките стойности на етапите на обучение.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Several lines, particularly those for N=3 through N=9, exhibit very clear oscillations (local peaks and troughs) between approximately x=100 and x=600. The description incorrectly states these features are not present.
The description omits that the lines for N=5 through N=9, and to some extent N=4, appear to converge to a similar value of approximately 43 by the end of the training epochs.
The x-axis has no visible label in the figure. The description fabricates this label, likely from the paper's caption.

errors.text_span: Die y-Achse ist mit einem linearen Skalentyp und einem Wertebereich von 40 bis 50 beschriftet
errors.evidence: The y-axis has no visible label in the figure, but the description claims it is labeled ('beschriftet').
The y-axis range shown in the plot extends above 50, with the data for N=1 starting at approximately 52. The stated range of 40 to 50 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: Die Linie für N = 1 beginnt bei ungefähr 52 und bleibt über den gesamten Bereich konstant.
errors.evidence: The line for N=1 does not remain constant over the entire range. It has a sharp initial drop from approximately 52 to 50 before becoming constant for the rest of the range.

errors.text_span: Die anderen Linien beginnen bei Werten zwischen ungefähr 49 und 51
errors.evidence: This range is incorrect. For example, the line for N=10 starts at approximately 47, which is outside the stated range of 49 to 51.
This description omits the distinct oscillations that are visible in many of the lines (specifically for N values from 3 to 9) before they stabilize. This is a prominent feature of the data.

errors.text_span: Die Linie für N = 10 beginnt bei ungefähr 50
errors.evidence: The line for N=10 (light blue) starts at a y-value of approximately 47, not 50.
